en.title: Federal Communications Commission: 19 references to provisions removed or redesignated by 2026 rules
en.summary: In the CFR chapters assigned to the Federal Communications Commission, 19 references in 13 sections still use an address that a 2026 final rule changed: 2 cite a section or part that a 2026 final rule removed; 17 cite a paragraph that a 2026 final rule removed or redesignated. Each rule was published in the Federal Register and in effect by October 27, 2026; the eCFR of that date keeps the old address.
en.impact: A reader who follows these references finds no text at the cited address, or text that the rule moved there from another paragraph. No effect on a decision or an amount has been established.
en.correction: The agency decides how to update each reference. Where the 2026 rule redesignated the paragraph, the evidence below gives the new designation.
